observations.body: Paul uses marriage and death-to-law language before saying the readers belong to the one raised from the dead so that they may bear fruit for God and serve in newness of Spirit.
observations.label: Union with the raised Christ is linked to fruit for God

observations.body: The passage presents Belonging and bearing fruit as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Belonging and bearing fruit

observations.body: The passage places Christ beside Belonging and bearing fruit.
observations.label: Christ

payload.posture: Read Romans 7:1–6 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.title: Union with the raised Christ is linked to fruit for God
